title: Reuse formatted GROUP BY ORDER BY function name
description: Move ORDER BY function display construction out of the column search loop for simple group aggregate fast paths.

criteria: Function ORDER BY matching remains case-insensitive against output column names
ORDER BY COUNT(*) and SUM(...) fast-path regressions pass

notes: The caller still uses func.to_string(), preserving the same display text as the previous format! call.
The formatted function name is created once per ORDER BY expression instead of once per candidate column.
